data.title: BioETL Runtime Detail Graph
data.description: Детализированный knowledge graph для coordination seams внутри application/core и composition/bootstrap/runtime в BioETL.

nodes.label: application/core
nodes.description: Координационное ядро исполнения пайплайнов, содержащее runner lifecycle, batch execution, transformer runtime и preflight/postrun семьи.

nodes.label: PipelineRunner
nodes.description: Главный application service, управляющий жизненным циклом запуска пайплайна, span lifecycle, checkpointing и вызовами preflight, execution и postrun.

nodes.label: PipelineService Bundle
nodes.description: Frozen DI bundle прикладных сервисов и портов, которые используются раннером и execution-потоками без service locator паттерна.

nodes.label: Preflight Service Family
nodes.description: Семейство preflight-модулей для health aggregation, medallion validation, reporting и strict startup blocking.

nodes.label: Postrun Service Family
nodes.description: Семейство postrun-модулей для compaction, DQ evaluation, DQ reporting, metadata writes и vacuum finalization.

nodes.label: Lifecycle Family
nodes.description: Подсемейство управления блокировками, checkpoint runtime, heartbeat, cleanup и shutdown semantics внутри application/core.

nodes.label: Batch Execution Family
nodes.description: Семейство модулей для batch execution contracts, run service, state service и supporting execution flows.

nodes.label: Batch Processing Seam
nodes.description: Шов обработки извлечённых batch-ей, связывающий transformation, writing, runtime failure policy, metrics и progress accounting.

nodes.label: Base Transformer Family
nodes.description: Базовое семейство трансформеров с template-method semantics, structural policy rules и runtime collaborator support.

nodes.label: Transformer Runtime Family
nodes.description: Подсемейство orchestration, attempts, finalization, quarantine, state и streaming semantics для runtime поведения трансформеров.

nodes.label: Core Observability Hooks
nodes.description: Набор batch metrics, tracing и span helper модулей, встроенных прямо в execution-потоки application/core.

nodes.label: composition/bootstrap/runtime
nodes.description: Runtime assembly зона composition layer, где собираются PipelineRunner, CompositePipelineRunner и observability/control-plane collaborators.

nodes.label: Pipeline Bootstrap
nodes.description: Фасадный runtime entrypoint для bootstrap_pipeline_runner, который регистрирует провайдеры и делегирует сборку в builder-слой.

nodes.label: Runner Assembly
nodes.description: Семейство assembly-модулей для создания runner service payloads, dependency bundles и composite runner wiring.

nodes.label: Composite Bootstrap
nodes.description: Composite runtime bootstrap со сборкой support services, runner factories, infrastructure context и final composite runner.

nodes.label: Observability Bootstrap
nodes.description: Bootstrap logger, metrics, tracing и DQ monitor ports в validated observability bundle для runtime execution.

nodes.label: Service Bootstrap
nodes.description: Набор bootstrap-модулей для DQ, classification init, runner service assembly и других runtime service seams.

nodes.label: runtime_builders
nodes.description: Leaf-builder слой, который готовит runner inputs, observability bundle, config access и control-plane attachment до создания раннера.

nodes.label: Control Plane
nodes.description: Manifest и run-ledger collaborators, которые связывают runtime bootstrap с append-only execution evidence и artifact lifecycle.

nodes.label: Provider Registry
nodes.description: Реестр провайдеров и pipeline registrations, который инициализируется до runtime assembly и удерживает deterministic registration state.

nodes.label: Config Access Seams
nodes.description: Канонические seams доступа к settings и YAML-конфигам, вынесенные из runtime bootstrap в dedicated config owners и builder wrappers.

nodes.label: PipelineRunner Instance
nodes.description: Сконфигурированный экземпляр PipelineRunner, который composition layer возвращает как готовую runtime единицу исполнения.

nodes.label: CompositePipelineRunner
nodes.description: Сервис composite execution, который координирует seed, dependency и enricher runner factories через typed dependency bundle.

nodes.label: Observability Bundle
nodes.description: Собранный logger, metrics, tracer и DQ monitor bundle, который передаётся в runtime execution и preflight validation.

edges.description: application/core centers PipelineRunner as the orchestration hub that coordinates managed execution, span lifecycle, checkpoint loading, and postrun completion across the whole pipeline flow.
PipelineRunner depends on PipelineService Bundle to receive storage, source, and collaborator ports through explicit dependency injection instead of constructing technical services internally.
PipelineRunner invokes the Preflight Service Family before execution so that infrastructure health and medallion policy validation can block invalid runs early.
PipelineRunner delegates finalization to the Postrun Service Family so that DQ evaluation, reports, metadata writes, compaction, and vacuum stay outside the main runner class.
PipelineRunner relies on the Lifecycle Family for lock coordination, checkpoint handling, shutdown semantics, heartbeat signaling, and cleanup policies during a run.
PipelineRunner routes the main execution cycle into the Batch Execution Family, which encapsulates contracts, state transitions, and run-service logic for batch-oriented workflows.
The Batch Execution Family depends on the Batch Processing Seam to transform extracted records, track runtime state, and move processed batches toward medallion writers.
The Batch Processing Seam uses the Base Transformer Family to enforce shared transformation policy, structural rules, and template-method behavior across provider-specific transformers.
The Base Transformer Family is complemented by the Transformer Runtime Family, which isolates attempts, streaming, quarantine, and finalization behaviors from base transformer policy definitions.

The Preflight Service Family emits metrics and reporting signals through Core Observability Hooks so validation outcomes become visible without embedding infrastructure logging details into validation rules.
The Postrun Service Family enriches tracing spans and metrics through Core Observability Hooks so DQ status and postrun outcomes remain observable after execution finishes.
composition/bootstrap/runtime exposes Pipeline Bootstrap as the canonical entrypoint that prepares registration state and then delegates runner creation to deeper builder seams.
composition/bootstrap/runtime exposes Composite Bootstrap as the canonical assembly facade for composite execution, support services, and composite runner construction.
composition/bootstrap/runtime contains an Observability Bootstrap family that builds logger, metrics, tracer, and DQ monitor implementations before execution begins.
composition/bootstrap/runtime also contains Service Bootstrap seams for classification initialization, DQ wiring, and runner-service-specific assembly helpers needed during startup.
Pipeline Bootstrap depends on Provider Registry and explicit registration calls so all providers and pipelines are loaded deterministically before runtime runner creation.
Pipeline Bootstrap delegates the actual construction of a ready-to-run runner to runtime_builders, keeping the entrypoint focused on orchestration rather than low-level assembly steps.
runtime_builders depend on Config Access Seams to retrieve settings, pipeline config, and source config through canonical owners instead of performing raw config loading themselves.
runtime_builders use the Observability Bootstrap family to create an execution-ready observability bundle before the final runner object is instantiated.
runtime_builders integrate Control Plane collaborators so manifests and ledger attachments exist before runner execution and can propagate manifest identifiers into runtime context.
The Observability Bootstrap family produces the Observability Bundle by composing concrete logger, metrics, tracing, and DQ monitor implementations behind port-shaped interfaces.
runtime_builders ultimately create the PipelineRunner Instance after resolving inputs, attaching control-plane collaborators, and binding observability and manifest context.
The PipelineRunner Instance is the concrete runtime realization of PipelineRunner, carrying injected services and dependencies assembled by the composition layer.
The Observability Bundle feeds Core Observability Hooks so application execution paths can emit tracing and metrics without directly constructing observability infrastructure.
Composite Bootstrap depends on Runner Assembly helpers to expand support-service bundles into typed payloads and final composite runner dependency bundles.
Composite Bootstrap reuses Pipeline Bootstrap indirectly through runner-factory builders, because composite phases need seed and enrichment runners assembled through the normal pipeline path.
Runner Assembly materializes CompositePipelineRunner by bundling typed dependencies such as coordinator, merger, checkpoint manager, factories, and optional ledger collaborators.
Composite Bootstrap can propagate manifest and run-ledger context through support-service bundles so composite execution remains linked to append-only control-plane evidence.
CompositePipelineRunner coordinates multiple PipelineRunner Instance factories for seed, dependency, and enricher phases instead of duplicating single-pipeline runtime logic.
The Preflight Service Family depends conceptually on Config Access Seams because medallion policy validation only makes sense after configuration has been canonically loaded and normalized.
Control Plane augments PipelineRunner with manifest identifiers and ledger collaborators so execution can emit stable artifacts and append-only lifecycle evidence.
